complaint_text: J ai recu 5 bouteilles de Coca-Cola cassees a Rouiba.
summary: The customer reported receiving 5 broken Coca-Cola bottles in Rouiba.
client_reply: Bonjour, nous vous remercions de nous avoir contactés pour nous faire part de ce problème. Soyez assuré que nous prenons votre situation très au sérieux afin de garantir la qualité de nos services de distribution. Un membre de notre équipe va examiner votre dossier et vous contactera prochainement pour assurer un suivi personnalisé. Votre réclamation a bien été enregistrée et transmise au département compétent.

complaint_text: Our scheduled delivery for Order #98765 was supposed to arrive on september 17th , but it was delayed by four days without any notification from your logistics team. Furthermore, upon inspecting the crates, we found that two cases of 1L Coca-Cola glass bottles had broken units and severe leakage, rendering 12 bottles unsellable.
summary: Order #98765 was delayed by four days without notification, and 12 glass bottles were found broken and unsellable upon delivery.
client_reply: Thank you for reaching out to us, and we sincerely apologize for the issues you experienced with Order #98765. We understand that your delivery was delayed by four days without notification and that two cases of 1L Coca-Cola glass bottles arrived with broken units and leakage. Please be assured that we take the quality of our distribution and the condition of our products very seriously. A member of our team will follow up with you shortly to address the 12 unsellable bottles and investigate the communication gap regarding your delivery. Your case has been officially logged and routed to the appropriate department for immediate review.
